north_star: One public source for vault policy, schemas, appearance, skills and reproducible updates.
wedge: A single numbered profile with standalone projects in 20-projects and programs in 21-* onward.
target_user: Obsidian users maintaining structured vaults with agents
core_promise: Versioned policy and deterministic checks without leaking content or overwriting local edits.
non_goals: No GitHub Actions, no automatic background writer, no mass content migration.
